subject: Investigation: sudden duplicate ingest causing invoice collection hold
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@alturalabs.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: Accounting <billing@alturalabs.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike on Nov 17-18 — invoice on hold

Hi Rafael,

We put the invoice on hold earlier this week because our AP flagged a ~4x usage spike on Nov 17-18 that doesn't line up with our activity. Our engineering team found a set of request IDs that look duplicated after our ingestion pipeline upgrade — I attached a short list of sample IDs to this email (sample_request_ids.txt).

Can you confirm whether Redwood saw an ingestion duplication or replay on those timestamps? Collections is refusing to release the hold until we have an explanation and some evidence. We need a summary and any logs you can provide for our auditors.

Appreciate the quick help — we have a month-close deadline and this hold is blocking payment.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform
Altura Labs

Attachment: sample_request_ids.txt (text, 120 lines)
From: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@alturalabs.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike on Nov 17-18 — invoice on hold

Samira — thanks for the note and the IDs. We're looking into it now.

Quick summary of next steps from our side:
- I'll pull request traces and kernel telemetry for the Nov 17-18 window and look for obvious replay/duplicate ingestion patterns.
- If we confirm duplicate ingestion on Redwood's side we'll provide: a) a CSV of matching request IDs and timestamps, b) a short trace extract showing repeated payloads, c) a provisional credit proposal for the duplicated token count.
- If the cause is on Altura's side (replay from your ingest pipeline), we'll share the evidence and advise on how to dedupe going forward.

Can you confirm the timezone for the timestamps in sample_request_ids.txt (they look like UTC+0)? Also, any internal trace IDs you can share will speed up matching.

I'll escalate to our billing/collections team and loop Jordan for telemetry pulls. Expect an update by EOD Monday.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Team — forwarding Altura's sample IDs. Can one of you pull the raw request traces + kernel-level telemetry for Nov 17 00:00 to Nov 18 23:59 UTC and grep for these IDs. Key asks: 1) match request IDs and show duplicate occurrences, 2) provide token delta per request (approx), 3) include a short extract (single-request JSON traces) for the auditor.

If we confirm duplication on our side we should propose a provisional credit immediately (I suggest we credit the duplicated token count at the hosted API rate and offer to remove the collection hold pending Altura confirmation). If it's on their side we still need a clear packet of evidence to pass to collections so they release the hold.

Please attach telemetry_snippets.csv and request_trace_8421.json to your reply.

Thanks,
Rafael

--- Forwarded message from Samira Khan <samira@alturalabs.com> ---
> Attachment: sample_request_ids.txt (text, 120 lines)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Unexpected spike on Nov 17-18 — invoice on hold — please pull traces

Rafael / Jordan — attached are the pulls: telemetry_snippets.csv and request_trace_8421.json. Summary below.

Findings (high level):
- For 37 of the 120 sample IDs, we see exact duplicate ingestion events on the Redwood edge within a 2-4 second window (same payload checksum, same client IP reported in headers).
- Token impact: duplicated requests increased billed tokens by ~18,450 tokens across the sampled set; extrapolating across the full ingestion window our conservative estimate is ~62k duplicated tokens total.
- Root cause signal: in 22 of the duplicates we see repeated CONNECT/ACK sequences from the same source IP followed by identical POST body hashes — indicates client-side retry/replay during a brief proxy restart. No evidence of internal replay from Redwood scheduler/process restarts.

Attachments (for handoff to collections/auditor):
- telemetry_snippets.csv (cols: request_id, redwood_ts, client_ip, payload_hash, tokens, duplicated_flag)
- request_trace_8421.json (single-request extract showing repeated payload and headers)

Recommendation: offer a provisional credit covering the 62k-token conservative estimate at hosted API rate, and provide the telemetry CSV to Altura. Collections should lift the hold on receipt of the evidence and the credit offer; ask Altura to confirm whether they'll accept the credit or provide additional trace IDs.

Ben
Sr. Billing Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: telemetry_snippets.csv (CSV, 2.3MB)
Attachment: request_trace_8421.json (JSON, 18KB)
From: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@alturalabs.com>, Accounting <billing@alturalabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike on Nov 17-18 — invoice on hold

Hi Samira — thanks for your patience. We've completed our initial forensic review and attached the telemetry snippets and a request trace extract for your auditors. Short summary for AP and your audit team: 

- Evidence: We matched 37 sample IDs from your list that were ingested twice by our edge within a 2–4s window. We include telemetry_snippets.csv with the matching rows (request_id, redwood_ts, client_ip, payload_hash, tokens, duplicated_flag) and one representative trace in request_trace_8421.json.
- Cause (likely): signals point to client-side retries/replays (repeated CONNECT/ACK and identical payload hashes) during a transient proxy restart on your side; we found no internal Redwood replay patterns in the examined windows.
- Impact and Offer: conservative estimate of duplicated tokens for the full Nov 17-18 window is ~62,000 tokens. We're happy to apply a provisional credit for that amount at the hosted API rate (credit line will be posted to your account under invoice INV-20261118-ALT).
- Collections: once Altura confirms receipt and acceptance of the attached telemetry package and credit offer, Redwood will request collections to lift the invoice hold. If Altura wants Redwood to pursue a different remediation (e.g., partial credit, longer-term offset), let us know and we can discuss.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the timezone used in sample_request_ids.txt (ideally confirm UTC) and whether you want the credit posted as a line item adjustment or applied to the next invoice.
2) If you have additional request IDs beyond the sample, send them and we'll expand the match.

I've copied Ben and Jordan for follow-through on the account ledger and evidence packet.

Best regards,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0182
